model.note: Verified against snakers4/silero-models models.yml + examples_tts_cis.ipynb on 2026-09-09. Loaded via `from silero import silero_tts; model,_=silero_tts(language='ru',speaker='v5_cis_base')`. model.speakers lists every available voice id.

voronova.reason: model.speakers has no 'ru_larisa' — 'bel_larisa' exists only as the native-Belarusian voice, with no Russian-language ('ru_') variant shipped in this model release. No other ru_ speaker shares Larisa's Belarusian (East Slavic) origin, so the nearest still-unused ru_ voice was picked by hand for a mature/authoritative female timbre distinct from Leya's ru_ramilia.

markov.reason: model.speakers has no 'ru_anatoliy' (same gap as Larisa above — 'bel_anatoliy' has no 'ru_' variant). 'ru_roman' was chosen because its native origin is Ukrainian (bel/ukr are both East Slavic, the closest available linguistic family to Belarusian), keeping 'ru_igor' free as a spare male voice.

normalization.guillemets: stripped (« » removed, enclosed text kept as-is)
normalization.unsafeChars: anything outside [0-9A-Za-zА-Яа-яЁё' +.,!?:;-] stripped after dictionary substitution
normalization.trailingPunctuation: a '.' is appended if the normalized text doesn't already end in . ! or ?

stress.call: load_accentor(lang='ru') -> accentor(text) -> text with '+' before stressed vowels
stress.faultTolerant: try/except around accentor(); on failure the unstressed normalized text is used and the error is logged in voice-build-report.json — never blocks the rest of the build
stress.verifiedPreStressed: words already containing '+' (from pronunciation.json) are left untouched by accentor() and do not get double-marked (empirically verified 2026-09-09)

radio.note: applied to ALL 391 lines via ffmpeg (highpass, lowpass, a peaking EQ bump at 1800Hz, acompressor, loudnorm). radioOpen/radioClose stay separate existing SFX (audio.js), not baked into these files.

unknownRadio.note: applied ON TOP of the standard radio chain above, only for the 'unknown'/Sokolov character — deliberately light (no pitch shift / vocoder / robot effect), speech stays fully intelligible.

output.productionFormat: MP3 mono 24 kHz 48 kbps (falls back to 48 kHz mono 48 kbps if the encoder rejects 24 kHz)
